title: How to organize the diaper and care backstock | Nursery
description:
Holds the reserve that feeds the changing station, in the sizes your baby is about to need rather than the ones on offer.

This is the Diaper and Care Backstock in the Nursery. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
One unopened pack of the current size and no more than two of the next size on a low shelf, each size written large in marker on the short end, a wipes carton with its count visible, creams and thermometer in one lidded box, and nothing at all stored on a shelf above the crib.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Pull every pack off the shelf and read the printed size rather than trusting the picture on the front.
Straighten: Write the size in marker on the short end of every pack so it reads from the doorway, then shelve the current
Shine: Wipe the shelf down and check the undersides of the cartons for damp, since packs stored against an outside wa
Safety: Nothing heavy goes on a shelf above or beside the crib, because a carton that works its way off lands exactly
Standardize: Write the minimum and maximum on the shelf edge itself: never fewer than one unopened pack of the current size
Sustain: When the last diaper comes out of an open pack, the reserve pack moves forward to the front and the size goes

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
One size ahead, two packs deep, and nothing heavy stored above the crib.
